title: 一二扒
subject: twelve housewives from Shek Kip Mei Estate in a small dragon boat at a district Tuen Ng race against the fire station crew, one heat each and the final still to row
caption: Cantonese stadium games anthem in the style of a Hong Kong sports-games theme song. A trumpet and French-horn fanfare opening each chorus; timpani rolls into every section; a rudimental marching snare under a stadium kick and stacked hand-claps; a driving octave piano; a string ostinato under the verses; a massed SATB choir doubling the chorus, and a half-step key change into the last chorus. Big and roomy like an open-air riverside race, choir and brass wide, lead voices forward. Several middle-aged female lead voices trading lines in the verses, then all in unison with the full choir on the chorus, an open, stubborn belt, crowd shouts of 'one, two, paddle' as written in the lyrics. 124 BPM, Bb major rising to B major. Proud, loud and stubborn in the final. No EDM drop, no synth build, no trap beat, no rap, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
石硤尾邨 十二個師奶 著齊紅波衫
小龍舟練咗三個月 喺城門河
隔籬線 消防局 一船大隻佬
岸邊企滿 一排排嘅街坊

[Pre-Chorus]
手套戴好 腳板撐實
陳太坐船頭 一棍一棍 打落個鼓

[Chorus]
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
槳槳插落水 寸步都唔讓
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
成個河岸 同我哋一齊叫

[Verse]
第一輪輸咗 輸咗半個船頭
李太副眼鏡 跌咗落河底
第二輪 佢哋以為我哋冇氣
點知我哋個個 都搬過幾十斤米

[Pre-Chorus]
一比一 決賽 定輸贏
陳太個鼓 打快多兩拍

[Chorus]
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
槳槳插落水 寸步都唔讓
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
岸上岸下 嗌到成個邨都聽到

[Bridge]
我哋十二個 加埋六百幾歲
手掌啲繭 係揸菜刀揸出嚟
今日 揸實呢支槳

[Chorus]
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
槳槳插落水 寸步都唔讓
一、二、扒！ 一、二、扒！
個龍頭 一寸一寸 追返嚟

[Outro]
一、二、扒！
贏定輸 今晚都係我哋請食飯
